notes.content: Art students gain exposure to a broad spectrum of interconnected approaches to the making of art and the critical appreciation of art. Our faculty members are dedicated professional artists and scholars who bring a diverse range of experience and expertise to the classroom. Students benefit from close interaction and mentoring. The visual arts program is fully accredited by the National Association of Schools of Art and Design. All Art B.A.students must complete the studio concentration. Students interested in art history should explore the Art History B.A. or Art History Minor . View information for the Department of Art , including Learning Objectives for the department and its programs.
